description: This file defines a custom page route transition called FadeThroughPageRoute for Flutter, implementing a fade-through animation with optional scale effect, inspired by Material Motion. It manages the transition animations and respects the system's reduce motion setting.

classes.name: _NoContext
classes.description: A helper class implementing BuildContext that disables context usage, used to pass a dummy context to reduce motion duration calculations.
